definitions.explanation: Trying extremely hard with full effort, often in a dire situation.
A situation where death is unavoidable (literary/classical usage).

examples.japanese: {必死|ひっし}に{勉強|べんきょう}した。
{彼|かれ}は{必死|ひっし}の{形相|ぎょうそう}で{走|はし}っていた。
examples.english: He was running with a desperate look on his face.

examples.japanese: {必死|ひっし}になって{説得|せっとく}したが、{無駄|むだ}だった。
examples.english: I tried desperately to persuade them, but it was useless.

notes:
Often used adverbially with に to mean "desperately" or "frantically."

FORMS:
・{必死|ひっし}に〜する (to do something desperately)
・{必死|ひっし}になって (becoming desperate)
・{必死|ひっし}の + noun ({必死|ひっし}の{努力|どりょく} = desperate effort)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{必死|ひっし}に{働|はたら}く (to work frantically)
・{必死|ひっし}に{逃|に}げる (to flee desperately)
・{必死|ひっし}の{覚悟|かくご} (desperate resolve)
・{必死|ひっし}の{抵抗|ていこう} (desperate resistance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい} - with all one's might (more positive)
・{必死|ひっし} - desperate, frantic (implies urgency/danger)
